invention.ref: Washington Sheffield of New London, CT, puts toothpaste in a collapsible tube
invention.ref_zh: 新伦敦的谢菲尔德把牙膏装进可挤压软管

mass_production.ref: Colgate dental cream sold in collapsible tubes
mass_production.ref_zh: 高露洁牙膏开始用软管销售

locations.place_label_zh: 美国康涅狄格州新伦敦

notes: 年份有分歧：维基百科写作 1880 年，其他资料常写 1892 年，因此精度只标到十年。牙膏本身比软管古老得多。
summary_zh: 19 世纪 80 至 90 年代，康涅狄格州牙医华盛顿·谢菲尔德把牙膏装进可挤压的金属软管；1896 年高露洁跟进。
summary_en: In the 1880s–90s, Connecticut dentist Washington Sheffield put toothpaste into a collapsible tube; Colgate followed in 1896.

image.alt_zh: 浴室柜里的两支儿童牙膏
image.alt_en: Two toothpaste tubes in a bathroom cabinet

notes_en: Dates vary: Wikipedia says 1880, while other sources often give 1892, so only decade precision is used. Toothpaste itself is far older than the tube.
